calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY: same networking read-through — Nvidia's scale-up/scale-out domain improvements are very bullish for Astera Labs alongside Marvell and Credo.
New: Astera Labs is a key AI-supply-chain bottleneck (data-center networking rival to AVGO/ANET); sideways since June, likes it on the theme; among Amazon's 13F holdings via extended partnerships.
Part of his 'ETF approach' trio; scale-up/scale-out networking demand confirmed by Marvell's raised outlook; stock up ~8% on the day.
calls.base: Networking/connectivity is the shared driver behind both Marvell raises.
calls.bull: Others in optics/scale-up-scale-out could benefit too.
